title: Major TOM Core-S2RGB-SigLIP
description: Major TOM Core-S2RGB-SigLIP: one SigLIP embedding per 384 x 384 px fragment of the Major TOM Core Sentinel-2 L2A dataset, released by ESA Φ-lab and CloudFerro as part of the Major TOM embedding expansion. Global and dense over land; useful for similarity search, retrieval and frozen-feature probing.

review: emb:dimensions read from the dataset viewer (1.15k), matching SigLIP SO400M (1152).

processing:lineage: Each Major TOM Core grid cell (1068 x 1068 px at 10 m) is cut into 384 x 384 px fragments with a 10% target overlap and border shift (the last fragment touches the far edge), and each fragment is encoded once. RGB bands of Sentinel-2 L2A, reflectance x 2.5 clipped to [0, 1]. Image-text model: supports text queries.
temporal_coverage_note: Major TOM Core snapshots, one acquisition per grid cell; the paper and dataset card give no overall date range (TorchGeo lists 2015-2024, sparse, for the Major TOM embeddings).

paper.title: Global and Dense Embeddings of Earth: Major TOM Floating in the Latent Space

access_requirements: open download from Hugging Face, no account
